name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A single-part Input rendered inside a wrapping <label> with placeholder text, styled as a compact bordered text field (Tailwind variant and CSS Modules variant are behaviorally identical).
stateManaged: none — the input is fully uncontrolled with no value/defaultValue, no useState, and no event handlers; the browser owns the value
nonTrivialInteractions: the wrapping <label> element ('Name') provides the input's accessible name implicitly (native label association, no id/htmlFor or Field component)
no custom interactions beyond native input behavior; focus treatment and dark-mode/coarse-pointer text sizing are pure styling concerns
